result.reason: The redline provides 12-month automatic renewals, a 30-day non-renewal deadline, and a 60-day Vendor reminder, but it omits the required cap on renewal price increases. It otherwise preserves the term structure and makes limited changes. Drafting is weakened because “Such notice” most naturally refers to HDI’s reminder, incorrectly suggesting that the reminder must specify a termination date; it should instead refer expressly to any notice of non-renewal.
